titles.native: おジャ魔女どれみ ナ・イ・ショ

description:
Na-i-sho is a 13 episode OVA series with episodes taking place during the ~motto~ season. It is a bit more mature than the TV seasons, and looks to develop each of the five witches romantically. Hana is back to a baby, and the mahou shop is a bakery.

(Source: Anime News Network)
